public.summary: This prompt finds the right answer but wraps it in small talk. Make it return just the data.
public.goal: This prompt works — except it wraps its answer in conversational text and code fences, so the calling code cannot parse it. Fix it without changing what it extracts.
public.startingPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Please read the text below and extract all the Lumen product names you find. Return them as a JSON array so my code can parse it. Thanks!
public.exampleInput: Please send across 2× Lumen Pro licences and 1× Lumen Analytics add-on before the 15th.
gradedOn: Output is a bare JSON array — no code fences, no preamble
Still finds the same product names as before
Doesn't add products that aren't in the text
